title: Resolution No. 243 (2023) – Regarding the Permanent Opening of Applications for VSAT Service Licenses
text:
Resolution No. (243/2023)
Issued on: April 5, 2023
The Board of Directors,
- After reviewing Law No. (37) of 2014, regarding the establishment of the Communications
and Information Technology Regulatory Authority and its amendments,
- The Decree issued on 04/04/1979 regarding the civil service system and its amendments,
- Decree No. (144) of 2022, on forming the CITRA Board of Directors,
1 | Page

- Cabinet Resolution No. (993) of 2015, issued on 13/7/2015 on issuing the executive
regulations of Law No. (37) of 2014,
- Board of Directors’ meeting Decision No. (2/2023), issued on 14/03/2023 regarding Zajel
request for licensing VSAT,
- Regulation for VSAT service issued on 13/12/2017,
- Licensing and Services Committee’s Letter No. (2/2023), issued on 07/02/2023 regarding
opening the market, and
- Based on the interest of Work
DECIDED
Article (1)
Approving the permanent opening of applications for VSAT service licenses and
initiating the related procedures.
Article (2)
The competent authorities, each within its capacity, shall implement this decision,
and it shall be effective from the date of its issuance.
Omar Saud Al-Omar
Chairman
Communication and Information Technology Regulatory Authority
